author: British Museum
title: British Museum catalogue record for photograph Oc-B102-35

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a photograph attributed to Katherine Maria Routledge, dated circa 1919. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact. The museum's image page identifies this documentary representation, states image-specific CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms and supplies the required credit. The original JPEG was downloaded, visually reviewed against the catalogue description and preserved unchanged. The complete Description and the photograph's inscription identify an in-situ bird-man carving at Orongo; the record does not identify the individual carving as a separate MoSA object. The former site-targeted extraction is retained here after correcting the collection boundary: “Photograph (black and white); carving in stone, in-situ, of a bird-man; Orongo, Easter Island.” (Description) The site is not a collection object because its displacement is not under investigation.
